title: Bread, wheat or cracked wheat, with raisins, toasted

content.title: About
content.content: Bread made from whole wheat or cracked wheat with raisins, toasted to a golden crust. It contains whole grains, natural sweetness from raisins, and the aroma of toasting. Suitable for breakfast, a snack, or as a base for sandwiches.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Toasting enhances flavor and creates a crunchy crust.
Raisins add natural sugars, making the bread slightly sweet without added sugar.
Whole wheat retains more fiber and nutrients compared with white bread.
Traditionally this bread is common in Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisines.
Toasted bread stays fresher longer than soft bread.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Whole grains and raisins provide dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Wheat supplies thiamine, niacin, and folate, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Raisins are high in polyphenols, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports blood sugar balance
items.content: Fiber slows carbohydrate absorption, which can moderate glucose spikes.

items.title: Energy‑dense snack
items.content: The combination of complex carbs and natural sugars offers sustained satiety.

items.title: Wheat allergy / gluten sensitivity
items.content: People with celiac disease or gluten intolerance may experience adverse reactions.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Raisins increase overall sugar levels, so diabetics should monitor portion size.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Toasted bread is more calorie‑dense than regular bread, so portion control is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bread plain, spread with butter, cheese, or nut butter, use in sandwiches, toast to desired crispness, or serve alongside soups and salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight container. For longer shelf life, keep refrigerated to prevent drying out and mold growth.
